decisions.reason: The _v19 instruction governs names of newly delivered documents; it does not change the required legacy-content migration behavior or its historical V14 test reference.
Changing the version suffix of delivered documents does not alter bullet appearance, scaling, alignment, or level-four formatting.
The document naming instruction does not change the constraint that pasted content remain within page margins.
Using _v19 for newly sent document names does not change the Master template's role as the foundation for derived templates.
The delivery version suffix has no effect on numbered-list or multi-digit alignment behavior.
The naming change does not modify the required ability to insert manual line breaks after pasted content.
The source concerns document filename versioning, not the PBU prefix or Danish names used for styles inside the templates.
Renaming newly delivered documents with _v19 does not change the specified style system or its application across templates.
The filename version instruction does not change table paste stability, column boundaries, or the existing unresolved feasibility conflict.
The new document suffix does not alter Tab-driven level transitions, list hierarchy, alignment, or the existing workflow ambiguity.
Document filename versioning does not change the supported Microsoft Word environment or operational-reliability requirement.
The _v19 delivery naming instruction does not modify interactive-field label text, language, coverage, or hover behavior.
